fields.title: Google Maps lead record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Google's place data plus website enrichment. One LEAD row per business; ERROR rows carry _error instead of a payload. Split a run by recordType. Google adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query or identifier that produced this lead.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-tbm-map-search, S2-preview-place, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: search_failed, unresolvable_input, detail_failed or no_place_data.

_searchQuery.title: Search query
_searchQuery.description: The query this lead came from; null for directly supplied places.

name.title: Business name
name.description: Business name as shown on Google Maps.

primaryCategory.title: Primary category
primaryCategory.description: First category Google assigns, e.g. 'Dental clinic'.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: All categories Google assigns to the business.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number in Google's display format.

phoneLocal.title: Phone (local)
phoneLocal.description: Local dialling format where Google supplies one.

website.title: Website
website.description: Business website URL as listed on Google.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses found on the business website. Requires enrichment.

socialProfiles.title: Social profiles
socialProfiles.description: Handles found on the website, keyed by network: instagram, facebook, twitter, linkedin, youtube, tiktok, whatsapp, telegram.

websitePhones.title: Website phones
websitePhones.description: Phone numbers found in tel: links on the website.

enrichmentStatus.title: Enrichment status
enrichmentStatus.description: ok, ok_contact_page, not_attempted, http_<code>, or fetch_failed:<reason>.

enrichmentPagesFetched.title: Enrichment pages fetched
enrichmentPagesFetched.description: How many pages of the website were read (0-2).

addressParts.title: Address parts
addressParts.description: Address split into components as Google returns them.

addressWithName.title: Address with name
addressWithName.description: Business name plus full address in one string.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Real GPS latitude of the business.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Real GPS longitude of the business.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone of the business, e.g. Asia/Jakarta.

openingHours.title: Opening hours
openingHours.description: Weekly schedule: a list of {day, hours} entries.

openNow.title: Open now
openNow.description: Google's open/closed status line at scrape time, when present.

reviewsUrl.title: Reviews URL
reviewsUrl.description: Link to the business's Google reviews.

description.title: Description
description.description: Business description when Google supplies one.

googleMapsUrl.title: Google Maps URL
googleMapsUrl.description: Canonical Maps link rebuilt from the feature id.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code of the returned content.

openingHoursComplete.title: Opening hours complete
openingHoursComplete.description: True when the full 7-day schedule was captured. Google sometimes serves a reduced record carrying only today's hours; enable fetchPlaceDetails to fill those in.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for scanning a lead list.

outreach.title: Outreach list
outreach.description: Everything needed to contact the business, in the order you would work it.

locations.title: Locations & hours
locations.description: Geographic and scheduling view: coordinates, timezone and opening hours.
